snippet.title: Sojourn Saga Trailer
snippet.description:
Nothing leaves the Warren.

Sojourn Saga is a roguelite JRPG inspired by Lufia 2's Ancient Cave. Descend through ever-changing dungeon floors, fight in classic turn-based battles, and when you fall, wake up back in the tavern and go again.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3463690/Sojourn_Saga/
▶ Play the free demo: https://skotlaroc.itch.io/sojourn-saga

✦ Every floor is different. Procedurally generated dungeons with visible enemies. Sneak up from behind to strike first.
✦ Classic JRPG combat. Sable, Rumcat, Selene and One-Arm, each with their own battle skills, plus Kosuri, a companion who grows as you fight.
✦ Death is part of the journey. Fall in the Warren and wake in the tavern, where the story moves forward one return at a time.
✦ Bosses that tell you their moves. Read the telegraph, then guard, interrupt or burst her down.
✦ Some things make it out. Rare items can survive the Warren, but nobody knows why.

A solo-developed passion project, three years in the making.

Developed by larochegames

#JRPG #Roguelite #IndieGame #PixelArt #RPGMaker
